messages.subject: Error with Maaslin on galaxy
parts:
Dear Maaslin Users, 

I'm trying to use MaAsLin on Galaxy but I am always confronted with : 
1
A MaAsLin error has occurred
It typically happens when incorrect 'Last metadata row' was selected
For demo data please choose 'Weight'

I don't know if it is important for MaAsLin that the dataset not carry any blank cells...in case it is, I checked, there is no empty rows and no symbols other than _ or |. Of course, I uploaded it as a MaAsLin file. 

Worryingly, i get the same error when I try with the demo data. 

I tried using MaAsLin on two different Galaxy servers.

Is there anything else I should be attention to when uploading my data ?

Last question : does MaAsLin accept values with < or > ? (I deleted them from my data but it would be practical if I could use them.)

Thank you for your help !

Camille Fournier
